_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Uri gukina Golf (Imikino ya Kadi) - Umukino {player_id}.
Itegeko: Ureke amafaranga ya chini mu mukino umwe.
Ikiwa koloni zifanana, zongerwa ku ngufu 0.
Ibidandaro: A=1, 2-10=ibidandaro, J/Q=10, K=0

Imikorere (tumye ibara vyawe):
- '[draw]' - Tara ku kadi
- '[take]' - Tora ku rutonde rw'icye
- '[swap X Y]' - Badanya ikaro na ngozo X (intara) Y (koloni)
- '[discard]' - Cye ikaro

board.took:
Waryiye: {card} ku rutonde rw'icye
Ubasha [swap X Y] nayo (ntacye)

options.final_turns: Imikino ya mwisho! Amahitamo yawe: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Utegerezwa: [swap X Y] (ntushobora guta amakarata yo mu mugwi wo gutabwa)

message.knocked: Umukinyi {pid} aratsinzwe! Umukinnyi wese agira uwundi mwanya.
message.final_round: Umukinnyi {pid} {reason}! Buri mukinnyi mwingine anapata mizunguko imwe.

invalid.wrong_action: Utumye umukino umwe tu w'ibara: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], cyangwa [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Imirongo yo mu bubiko bw'ibikoresho yaheze!
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Ntushobora guheba ikarata yakuwe mu yindi, utegerezwa kuyisubiriza.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Uriye n'ikaro. Ubasha [swap X Y] cyangwa [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Ukeneye ikarata y'igicapo kugira ngo uhindurane.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Urakeneye ikarata yakuwe mu minwe kugira ngo uyitandukanye n'iyindi.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Aho ku ngozo si ku mwanya. Utumye intara 1-{max_row}, koloni 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Ntushobora gukomanga ufise ikarata y'umutsindo. Banza urangize uruja n'uruza rwawe.
invalid.already_knocked: Hari uwoba yaramaze gutangura urwo rugendo.
